name: Having Children Outside Of Marriage
overview: Scripture upholds the sacred union of marriage as the proper context for family, emphasizing that a man shall leave his parents and unite with his wife to become one flesh, as stated in Genesis 2:24. The Bible warns against children born outside of this covenant, as seen in Deuteronomy 23:2, which restricts such individuals from full participation in the congregation of the LORD. The call to rejoice with the wife of one's youth in Proverbs 5:18 further underscores the blessing of marital faithfulness. Ultimately, God's love and provision, shown in John 3:16, invites all to salvation, but His design for family life remains clear and intentional.
